combo_label: Breakfast × Puppets & Punch and Judy × Julia Donaldson

entries.clue: Minced pork in a skin, browned till dark; the British call it a banger
Stitched line down a cloth puppet's back, hidden by turning it inside out
Shiny new purchase the tall fellow hands over as a home for a mouse
Baked clusters of sweetened grain and nuts, crunchy over fruit
Wound-up figure of wheels and springs that moves with nobody behind it
Publisher whose children's list first put the deep dark wood into print
Peter Brough's cheeky schoolboy figure, a radio star of the 1950s
Little lost swinger shown elephant, snake and frog by a well-meaning butterfly
Italian city that gave the world Pulcinella, the hook-nosed ancestor of Mr Punch
Cured pork strips, smoked or unsmoked, spitting as they crisp
Bumpy, as the deep-dark-wood monster's knees are, just before his turned-out toes
Laid to the right of the plate, blade turned in, ready to cut and spread
